returned_textual_content: # Features ## Temporary tables If SQL parsing is enabled, the connector is able to correctly produce lineage if a temporary table is used in a SQL script or procedure. ```tsql CREATE TABLE #TempTable... ``` Lineage related to a temporary table will be displayed as transitions from source to target based on the permanent tables used in the query. ## Temporary Table Representation If SQL is parsed, temporary tables can be represented in the model similarly to a normal table. These can be distinguished by their `TABLE_TYPE` property being equal to `TEMP_TABLE`. Currently, creation of temporary tables in tempdb using the syntax below is not supported. ```tsql CREATE TABLE tempdb..temp1 (c1 INT); ```
